title: serve
description: The HTTP+SSE bridge for the dispatcher cockpit: expose the x-web command surface, the event streams, and a built cockpit UI on 127.0.0.1. Long-running; Ctrl-C to stop. Prints the pairing URL (with the token fragment) once at startup.

ui.description: directory of a built cockpit UI to host statically

rotateToken.description: re-mint the pairing token, print the new pairing URL, and exit
